headline: The 2% API-order survival finding is withdrawn: the denominator counted a throwaway probe run
subject: Seed entry. The measurement this feed exists because of.
what_was_claimed: Of 398 orders created through the API from 2026-08-26, only 8 (2%) still existed in OnSinch, against 51 of 52 (98%) raised in the UI. Measured 2026-09-02.
why_it_is_wrong: The numerator and denominator were OnSinch timelineAudits rows with action=order_created_via_api, not engine bookings. 200 of the 252 sampled rows land in a two-hour window on 2026-08-26 02:00-04:00 carrying names like 'ZZ POSTURE TEST A' and 'AMEND MATRIX - safe to delete' — a probe session created in order to be deleted. The window opens on the largest deliberate throwaway run in the project's history. The engine's own ledger held 90 creates ALL TIME against an audit log claiming 398 in one week. There is no population of 5,693 destroyed bookings.
what_replaces_it: 105 of 133 engine-created orders were gone from OnSinch as at 2026-09-15, of which 67 have another order for the same company on the same work date living today. A same-company same-date order is a CANDIDATE replacement, not proof of one. The live denominator today is 179 distinct engine-created order ids in conversation_state.state->'order_action_log', spanning 2026-08-06 to 2026-09-18.
how_it_survived: The withdrawal was written into the 09-03 handoff and the topic file. It never reached the one-line memory index, which kept asserting the 2% figure as a live unverified claim. On 2026-09-28 that stale line put the withdrawn number at position one of the next session's plan, ahead of four real blockers. A retraction lost to a summary because this repo had nowhere append-only to put a number. That is why this file exists.

subject: Needs-a-person flags on jobs that are over expire, twenty a sweep

subject: Docs and comments the code had outgrown say what the code now does

headline: TV header: done-today metric removed
subject: The TV header no longer shows a done-today count

subject: Every live route's handler is tested with its IO injected

subject: A TV card's job date sits straight after its R/J numbers, with the reply clock at the far side

subject: Dashboard tools can be dragged into any order by a grip, and the Live Feed is first by default

subject: An order named by its R number counts on any day it covers, not only its first

headline: Venue table 27/33 (81.8%, no model); venue sink 8/112 engine orders (7.1%); link judge 314/374 right, 14 wrong links (3.7%) vs the old rule's 28
subject: The venue table and the venue sink rate hand their scores to the session gate

venue_table_deterministic.dataset: study/gold.ts GOLD_VENUES, 33 phrasings, against .tmp-data/places.json (5567 places, file dated 2026-08-25)

venue_sink.instrument: scripts/venue-sink.ts: one SELECT, no OnSinch, no model

link_judge_b3.dataset: 392 hindsight-labelled link points (gold.jsonl: 356 by hand, 36 by stated R number; 18 unsure excluded), cases built 2026-10-03
link_judge_b3.instrument: .tmp-data/linkjudge/link-eval.mts --all (paid, 413 model calls, anthropic/claude-opus-4.6) rescored by rescore.mjs after the gold correction
link_judge_b3.gold_correction: 46 of 53 rule labels 'own-order' were wrong (the rule read the bound order's existence, and the bound order was usually the candidate); relabelled by hand before scoring
link_judge_b3.decision: Ben accepted B4 on 2026-10-04; SPARTAN_LINK_JUDGE=on and SPARTAN_LINK_MODEL pinned to the measured model in Vercel production

subject: The TV finds the OnSinch order staff booked by hand for a need the engine never bound, and greens it only on staff evidence

subject: A need matched to a hand-booked order shows that order's R/J numbers, and a found order no longer reads RR

headline: TV: tick square becomes a red Confirm button

headline: TV: +Nd removed from the weekday label

subject: A TV card's red or blue follows its need, so 'Order needs updated' is never red

subject: SPARTAN_PAUSED=1 stops the engine's intake, sweep and mail routes with a 503 while the app stays usable

subject: TV needs that resolve without an engine write go green; week-quiet needs sink
